summary: Verified new CPA PUT (full overwrite) + PATCH /status endpoints in cpa-service and their admin-dashboard frontend integration. Backend: mvn compile clean on cpa-service (JDK 21.0.2 + Maven 3.9.9 re-installed at /tmp/jdk-21.0.2 and /tmp/apache-maven-3.9.9 after pod restart). Wrote 2 new focused test classes (CpaServiceUpdateTest = Mockito, 9 tests; CpaControllerUpdateTest = @WebMvcTest, 6 tests) covering happy-path + 404 + 400 + 409 regression. 14/15 tests pass; 1 failure reveals a REAL bug in CpaService.updateStatus(cpaId, null) - it throws NullPointerException instead of the intended EbmsException(INVALID_STATUS) because Set.of('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED').contains(null) throws NPE on immutable Set. Frontend: served static/admin/index.html via python http.server + Playwright fetch mocking; all 6 flows pass - (1) new-cpa upload -> POST no modal, (2) existing-cpa upload -> overwrite modal shown with correct cpaId, (3) modal cancel -> no PUT/POST, (4) modal confirm -> PUT + 'overschreven' success msg, (5) fetch existing -> status-toggle wrap visible with ACTIVE + 'Suspenderen' button, (6) toggle click -> PATCH with {status:'SUSPENDED'} + label/button update in place; Berichten tab still renders unchanged.

critical.issue: When request body is {"status": null} or the value normalises to null, CpaService.updateStatus throws java.lang.NullPointerException in Set.of("ACTIVE","SUSPENDED").contains(null) at CpaService.java:174. Expected behaviour per spec: EbmsException(INVALID_STATUS) -> HTTP 400 ProblemDetail. Currently the @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class) in CpaErrorHandler will catch it and return 500 Internal Server Error, which is a broken API contract. Fix: change the guard to `if (normalized == null || !ALLOWED_TOGGLE_STATUSES.contains(normalized))` OR normalise blank/null earlier and always throw EbmsException(INVALID_STATUS) before the Set lookup.

action_items: Fix NPE in CpaService.updateStatus() when status parameter is null - add explicit null guard before Set.of(...).contains() check so it throws EbmsException(INVALID_STATUS) (HTTP 400) instead of NullPointerException (which currently maps to HTTP 500).
critical_code_review_comments: Set.of(...) is immutable and throws NPE on .contains(null) - always null-check before calling contains() on immutable Sets.

CpaService.update() blindly overwrites the entity's version field from the DTO; if a caller sends null version, it silently wipes the previously-set version. Consider preserving existing value when dto.getVersion() is null (same pattern already used for status).

StatusUpdateRequest has no @NotBlank / @Valid annotation on the status field - a completely empty JSON body {} deserialises to status=null and currently triggers the NPE noted above. Add Bean Validation to fail fast with a 400 at the binding layer.

CpaErrorHandler maps every non-'ALREADY_EXISTS' EbmsException to 400 via a substring check on the error code - fragile; consider an explicit HttpStatus mapping (Map<String,HttpStatus>) or a status field on EbmsException itself.

rca of the issue: Bug: PATCH /api/cpa/{cpaId}/status with body {"status": null} returns HTTP 500 instead of 400. Reproduction: `curl -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":null}' http://<host>/api/cpa/<some-existing-cpa>/status`. Root cause: CpaService.java line 173-174: `String normalized = status == null ? null : status.trim().toUpperCase();` produces null, then `ALLOWED_TOGGLE_STATUSES.contains(normalized)` is Set.of(...).contains(null) which is documented to throw NullPointerException in Java's immutable Set implementations (ImmutableCollections.Set12.contains). The NPE bubbles up to CpaErrorHandler.handleGeneral -> 500. Mitigation: add explicit null/blank check before the Set lookup, e.g. `if (normalized == null || !ALLOWED_TOGGLE_STATUSES.contains(normalized)) { throw new EbmsException("INVALID_STATUS", ...); }` - matches the spec's 'throws EbmsException(INVALID_STATUS) for any other value (e.g. FOO, null, blank)'.
